cue: Wave one hand side to side (Hello / Hi)
description: The robot raises its arm to a friendly, visible height, then performs a repetitive side-to-side wrist movement to simulate a greeting wave, before smoothly returning to a more neutral posture.

cue: Raise one hand briefly (Greeting / Acknowledgement)
description: The robot arm moves upward to a high position, holds briefly to signal attention or acknowledgement, and then returns to a neutral, lowered position.

cue: Bow slightly from the waist (Respect / Greeting)
description: The robot performs a slight bow by bending at the 'waist' (simulated by the shoulder joint's forward tilt), holds briefly to convey respect or a greeting, and then returns to an upright neutral position.

cue: Extend one hand vertically forward as if offering a handshake (Asking for handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the gripper oriented vertically, mimicking the gesture of offering a handshake. It holds the pose briefly to signify an invitation, then retracts to a neutral position.

cue: Move one hand up and down vertically as if shaking someone’s hand (Imitating handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the gripper oriented vertically, mimicking the starting position of a handshake. It then performs several rapid vertical up-and-down movements, simulating the 'shake', before gently lowering and retracting the arm to conclude.

cue: Wrap both arms around yourself (Hug / Comfort)
description: The robot begins with arms slightly extended and ready (setup), then swiftly brings both arms inward and across its body, bending the elbows to simulate a self-hug (core action), holding the embrace for comfort, before slowly relaxing and returning its arms to a neutral, lowered position (follow-through).

cue: Bring fingertips to lips and blow outward (Blow a kiss)
description: The robot first sets a ready pose, then gracefully brings its gathered fingertips near its lips, holds briefly to 'collect' the kiss, then extends its hand forward with a quick, gentle push as if blowing a kiss, and finally concludes with a soft arm retraction to a relaxed, lowered position.

cue: Form a big heart shape above head (Love)
description: The robot first raises its arm overhead to a central starting point with an open hand, then traces a sweeping arc down and to its left, continuing the arc from the bottom point upwards and to its right, completing a large heart shape above its head. It finishes with a brief hold in a celebratory pose.

cue: Place one hand over chest (Sincerity / Gratitude)
description: The robot brings its arm from a neutral position, bending the elbow to place its hand flat over the center of its chest, holding it there briefly to convey sincerity, gratitude, or a pledge.

cue: Raise both fists upward (Victory / Excitement)
description: The robot starts with arms slightly retracted, then performs a swift, powerful upward thrust with both arms (representing fists), holding briefly at the peak, followed by a slight celebratory shake, and finishing in a proud, elevated stance.

cue: Pump one fist downward (Success / Yes!)
description: The robot raises its arm to a high, ready position (setup), then executes a powerful, fast downward pump with the arm, holding briefly at the bottom to emphasize success (core action), followed by a small celebratory jolt (follow-through).

cue: Flex one arm to show bicep (Strength)
description: The robot positions its arm to the side and slightly forward, then performs a strong, visible bicep curl with a brief hold to indicate strength, before slowly relaxing the arm back to a neutral position.

cue: Nod head up and down (Yes)
description: The robot starts in a neutral position, then performs a distinct series of downward and upward movements simulating a head nod to signify agreement or affirmation.

cue: Shake head side to side (No)
description: The robot positions its gripper as a 'head' at an elevated, slightly forward position, then performs a series of rapid lateral rotations of the 'head' (simulated by the arm's shoulder joint) to indicate negation or disagreement. It finishes by returning to a centered, slightly settled posture.

cue: Shrug shoulders with palms up (I don’t know)
description: The robot starts with a neutral arm position, then quickly raises its arm as if shrugging its shoulders, simultaneously turning its gripper to face upwards (palms up), holding the pose to convey 'I don't know' or uncertainty, before slowly returning to a relaxed stance.

cue: Scratch head lightly (Confusion)
description: The robot raises its arm to the side of its head, performs a small, light scratching motion with its wrist to indicate confusion, then subtly shifts before returning to a neutral posture.

cue: Tilt head slightly (Curiosity)
description: The robot positions its gripper as a 'head', then performs a subtle lateral tilt of the entire arm to one side, holding the pose briefly to convey a sense of curiosity or attentive listening, before making a slight adjustment.

cue: Place palm over face (Facepalm / Frustration)
description: The robot raises its arm into position, then brings its palm to cover its face, holding briefly to convey frustration or exasperation, and finally lowers the arm slowly.

cue: Point to chest with index finger (Me)
description: The robot brings its arm towards its chest, with the gripper tip pointing towards its body, as if indicating 'me' or 'I'. The gesture emphasizes self-reference.

cue: Point forward with index finger (You)
description: The robot raises its arm to a mid-level position, quickly extends it forward and slightly upward to point, holds the pointing gesture briefly, then smoothly retracts to a more relaxed position.

cue: Turn palm downward and curl fingers inward repeatedly (Come here / Beckon)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the palm facing down, then repeatedly curls its fingers inward (by oscillating the wrist along its Z-axis) as if beckoning someone to approach, finishing by slightly lowering the arm.
validation_warnings: Beckon cue should have a clear repeated core action with repetition 3-5

cue: Extend palm forward flat (Stop)
description: The robot quickly extends its arm forward with the palm flat and facing away, holding the position firmly to signal 'stop', then retracts slightly.

cue: Raise index finger upright (One moment / Important point)
description: The robot positions its arm to a ready state, then raises its arm sharply and points its gripper upward, holding the pose to signify a 'one moment' request or an 'important point', before relaxing slightly.

cue: Place index finger on lips (Shh / Be quiet)
description: The robot positions its arm with the gripper oriented vertically, then brings its 'hand' (gripper) close to its 'mouth' area, makes a slight 'touch' gesture as if placing an index finger on lips, holds for emphasis, and then retracts.

cue: Pat stomach lightly (Hungry / Full)
description: The robot brings its hand to the lower abdomen area, performs a series of light, gentle patting motions, and then finishes with a subtle back-and-forth rub to express hunger, fullness, or mild discomfort.

cue: Rub both upper arms (Cold)
description: The robot brings its arm inward and upward into a 'hugging oneself' posture, performs a repetitive back-and-forth rubbing motion on its upper arm to simulate warmth, and then finishes with a slight slump, conveying a sense of cold or discomfort.

cue: Fan face with one hand (Hot)
description: The robot raises one hand near its face, then rapidly moves it back and forth as if fanning itself to signal heat or discomfort, before slowly lowering the arm.

cue: Open mouth wide and cover it (Sleepy / Yawn)
description: The robot first assumes a relaxed, slightly stretched posture as if preparing to yawn. It then quickly brings its hand up to simulate covering a wide-open mouth, holds briefly, and finally slowly lowers the arm in a sleepy manner.

cue: Rub one eye (Tired)
description: The robot slowly raises its arm to the side of its head, positions its gripper near one eye, performs a small circular rubbing motion to convey tiredness, and then slowly lowers its arm.

cue: Bow deeply while hands at sides (Apology)
description: The robot starts in a neutral stance with arms lowered, then performs a slow, deep bow by rotating its shoulder forward and slightly adjusting the elbow to maintain a 'hands at sides' appearance, holds the bowed position to express sincerity, and finally returns to its initial upright posture.

cue: Raise both hands and flex index and middle fingers twice (Air quotes)
description: The robot raises its arm to a forward, shoulder-height position with the gripper opening horizontally, then performs two distinct 'flexing' motions with its wrist to mimic air quotes, before returning to a neutral wrist position.

cue: Tap temple with index finger (Think / Smart)
description: The robot raises its arm to the side of its head, brings the gripper (simulating an index finger) to the temple, performs a series of light tapping motions, then lowers and retracts the arm to a relaxed position.

cue: Rotate index finger near temple (Crazy)
description: The robot raises its arm to the side of its head, then traces small circles near the temple to signal 'crazy' or 'thinking too hard'.

cue: Slide index finger across lips like zipping (Secret / Won’t tell)
description: The robot positions its hand near its mouth, then moves its 'index finger' (gripper) horizontally across the lips as if zipping them shut, holding the 'zipped' position briefly, and finally lowering the arm to a relaxed state.

cue: Cross arms over chest (Defensive)
description: The robot brings its arm across its body to the opposite side of the chest, tucking it in to signal a closed-off, defensive, or unapproachable posture. This motion combines a lateral sweep with a final tuck and hold.

cue: Place both hands on hips (Confidence / Annoyed)
description: The robot positions its arm to the side, then bends its elbow to place its hand on its hip, holding the pose to express confidence or annoyance, before returning to a neutral stance.

cue: Lean forward slightly with palms open (Interest)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the gripper opening facing upwards, then gently leans its body slightly forward to signal active interest and an open, receptive posture.

cue: Step back slightly with both palms raised outward (Shock / Surprise)
description: The robot quickly retracts its arm and raises its hand with the 'palm' facing forward, as if in sudden shock or surprise. The motion emphasizes a sharp recoil and an open, defensive posture.

cue: Cover mouth with palm (Gasp / Oops)
description: The robot quickly brings its palm to cover its mouth, holding the position to convey surprise or embarrassment, then slowly lowers its arm to regain composure.

cue: Press palms together and bow slightly (Thank you / Respect)
description: The robot brings its gripper faces together in front of its body, slightly to the right of center, then performs a gentle bow while holding the 'palms together' position to convey gratitude or respect, before slowly returning to a neutral, slightly separated pose.

cue: Raise one hand as if holding an invisible glass (Cheers)
description: The robot brings its arm up and forward, as if holding a glass for a toast, holds it briefly, performs a subtle 'clink' motion, then slowly lowers its arm to a composed position.

cue: Raise one palm upward as if inviting a high five (Asking for high five)
description: The robot positions its arm slightly forward and lowered in a neutral stance. It then raises its arm to high-five height, actively rotating the wrist to present the palm upward, holding the gesture, before slightly lowering the arm in a relaxed follow-through.

cue: Swing one raised palm downward as if high-fiving air (Imitating high five)
description: The robot raises its arm to a high, open-palm position as if preparing for a high five (setup), then executes a sharp, powerful downward swing as if making contact in mid-air (core action), followed by a subtle upward recoil as a natural follow-through.

cue: Extend one fist forward (Asking for fist bump)
description: The robot starts with its arm in a neutral, slightly retracted position (setup), then quickly extends its arm and 'fist' directly forward, holding it for a brief moment for a potential interaction (core action), before subtly retracting to a relaxed state (follow-through).

cue: Tap one fist lightly against your other palm (Imitating fist bump)
description: The robot extends its gripper to a central, slightly lowered front position, orienting it like a fist ready to tap (setup). It then pulls back slightly to gather momentum, performs a quick forward tap against an imaginary palm, followed by a slight recoil (core action). Finally, the arm retracts to a relaxed posture, holding briefly (follow-through).

cue: Pat your own back (Encouragement)
description: The robot positions its arm over its shoulder to reach its back (setup), then performs several quick patting motions (core action), and finally retracts the arm to a relaxed posture (follow-through).

cue: Draw a circle in the air with index finger (Repeat / Around)
description: The robot raises its arm to a comfortable drawing position in front of it, then traces multiple circles in the air with its gripper (as if using an index finger to point and draw), finally retracting slightly to a relaxed posture.

cue: Slice flat hand horizontally across throat (Cut / Stop it)
description: The robot positions a flat hand near its neck, then makes a sharp, decisive horizontal motion across the throat to signal 'cut', 'stop', or 'threat'.

cue: Swipe back of fingers outward from under chin (Dismissive / Whatever)
description: The robot brings its arm up to position the back of its fingers just under the chin, with the palm facing towards its own body. It then performs a swift and decisive outward swipe, often accompanied by a slight upward flick, conveying a dismissive 'whatever' or 'get lost' sentiment.

cue: Drum fingers on table or in air (Waiting / Bored)
description: The robot positions its arm forward and slightly down, as if resting near a surface. It then performs a rapid, repetitive tapping motion, primarily using the wrist, to convey impatience or boredom, before settling back.

cue: Turn palm upward and curl fingers inward (Give me)
description: The robot transitions from a neutral arm position, then actively rotates its wrist to present the palm upward, finally performing a quick, repeated inward-curling motion with the wrist, mimicking a 'give me' or 'come here' gesture, before returning to a relaxed, palm-up posture.

cue: Extend open palm upward steadily (Offering)
description: The robot starts with its arm slightly forward and low, palm open and horizontal (ready to receive or offer). It then smoothly extends its arm upward and further forward, presenting the open palm in a steady, deliberate manner, holding the gesture as if offering an item or a service.

cue: Raise both hands beside head (I give up / Surrender)
description: The robot quickly raises its arm from a neutral, slightly forward position to a high, open-palmed posture beside its head, holds briefly to signify surrender or helplessness, then slowly lowers the arm to a relaxed state.

cue: Cover both ears (Too loud / Don’t want to hear)
description: The robot raises its arm to one side of its head, bringing the gripper flush against the 'ear' area as if blocking out sound, holding briefly to signal aversion to noise, and then slowly lowering the arm.

cue: Open both arms wide outward (Welcome)
description: The robot extends one arm forward and slightly down, with the gripper opening horizontal (palms up), then sweeps it wide outwards and slightly upwards as if to embrace or welcome, holding the open gesture briefly, before returning to a relaxed, neutral position.

cue: Stretch both arms upward (Relief / Stretch)
description: The robot begins in a neutral, slightly lowered stance. It then slowly extends both arms upward and slightly backward, as if reaching for the sky in a full-body stretch, holding briefly at the peak of the stretch, before gently lowering the arms back to a relaxed position.

cue: Bring one hand to forehead in salute position (Salute)
description: The robot executes a formal salute by smoothly raising its right arm, bending the elbow to bring the hand near the forehead, and holding it in a crisp, palm-down orientation before lowering it.

cue: Place one hand above eyebrows as visor and look far (Searching distance)
description: The robot positions its hand above its 'eyebrows' like a visor, then slowly scans left and right as if searching for something in the distance, before returning the arm to a relaxed position.
